item.text: Config uses Viper, and the CLI already has a `/meta/info` handler. I’ll add the telemetry settings there, move that handler into `internal/info`, and start the reporter from the server lifecycle. The reporter will log failures without stopping the server.
The reporter and startup wiring are in place. I’m checking the scheduling logic now, then I’ll verify opt-out behavior, stable state, and the event payload with local HTTP tests.

/bin/bash -lc "cat > telemetry/telemetry_test.go <<'EOF'
package telemetry

import (
    \"context\"
    \"encoding/json\"
    \"net/http\"
    \"net/http/httptest\"
    \"os\"
    \"path/filepath\"
    \"testing\"
    \"time\"

    \"github.com/gofrs/uuid\"
    \"github.com/markphelps/flipt/config\"
    \"github.com/markphelps/flipt/internal/info\"
    \"github.com/sirupsen/logrus\"
    \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestDisabled(t *testing.T) {
    dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent\")
    cfg := config.Default()
    cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled = false
    cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = dir
    r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.Nil(t, r)
    _, err = os.Stat(dir)
    require.True(t, os.IsNotExist(err))
}

func TestDirectoryIsFile(t *testing.T) {
    path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"file\")
    require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(\"x\"), 0600))
    cfg := config.Default()
    cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = path
    r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.Error(t, err)
    require.Nil(t, r)
}

func TestReportAndPersistentIdentity(t *testing.T) {
    dir := t.TempDir()
    cfg := config.Default()
    cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = dir
    r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.NoError(t, err)
    path := filepath.Join(dir, \"telemetry.json\")
    before := readState(t, path)
    require.Equal(t, schemaVersion, before.Version)
    _, err = uuid.FromString(before.UUID)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.Empty(t, before.LastTimestamp)

    previous := info.Version
    info.Version = \"v1.2.3\"
    defer func() { info.Version = previous }()
    calls := 0
    srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) {
        calls++
        require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, req.Method)
        var got event
        require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&got))
        require.Equal(t, \"flipt.ping\", got.Event)
        require.Equal(t, before.UUID, got.AnonymousID)
        require.Equal(t, before.UUID, got.Properties.UUID)
        require.Equal(t, schemaVersion, got.Properties.Version)
        require.Equal(t, \"v1.2.3\", got.Properties.Flipt.Version)
        require.Equal(t, \"0.0.0.0\", got.Context.IP)
    }))
    defer srv.Close()
    r.url = srv.URL
    require.NoError(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
    require.Equal(t, 1, calls)
    after := readState(t, path)
    require.Equal(t, before.UUID, after.UUID)
    _, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, after.LastTimestamp)
    require.NoError(t, err)

    again, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.Equal(t, before.UUID, again.state.UUID)
}

func TestFailedReportDoesNotAdvanceTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
    cfg := config.Default()
    cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
    r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.NoError(t, err)
    srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadGateway) }))
    defer srv.Close()
    r.url = srv.URL
    require.Error(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
    require.Empty(t, readState(t, r.path).LastTimestamp)
}

func TestMalformedStateGetsNewIdentity(t *testing.T) {
    cfg := config.Default()
    cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
    path := filepath.Join(cfg.Meta.StateDirectory, \"telemetry.json\")
    require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("'`{"uuid":"bad","lastTimestamp":"invalid"}`), 0600))
    r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.NoError(t, err)
    _, err = uuid.FromString(r.state.UUID)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.Empty(t, r.state.LastTimestamp)
}

func readState(t *testing.T, path string) state {
    t.Helper()
    data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    var s state
    require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &s))
    return s
}
EOF
gofmt -w telemetry/telemetry.go telemetry/telemetry_test.go
'

        require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, req.Method)
        var got event
        require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(req.Body).Decode(&got))
        require.Equal(t, \"flipt.ping\", got.Event)
        require.Equal(t, before.UUID, got.AnonymousID)
        require.Equal(t, before.UUID, got.Properties.UUID)
        require.Equal(t, schemaVersion, got.Properties.Version)
        require.Equal(t, \"v1.2.3\", got.Properties.Flipt.Version)
        require.Equal(t, \"0.0.0.0\", got.Context.IP)
    }))
    defer srv.Close()
    r.url = srv.URL
    require.NoError(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
    require.Equal(t, 1, calls)
    after := readState(t, path)
    require.Equal(t, before.UUID, after.UUID)
    _, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, after.LastTimestamp)
    require.NoError(t, err)

    again, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.Equal(t, before.UUID, again.state.UUID)
}

func TestFailedReportDoesNotAdvanceTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
    cfg := config.Default()
    cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
    r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.NoError(t, err)
    srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, req *http.Request) { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadGateway) }))
    defer srv.Close()
    r.url = srv.URL
    require.Error(t, r.Report(context.Background()))
    require.Empty(t, readState(t, r.path).LastTimestamp)
}

func TestMalformedStateGetsNewIdentity(t *testing.T) {
    cfg := config.Default()
    cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = t.TempDir()
    path := filepath.Join(cfg.Meta.StateDirectory, \"telemetry.json\")
    require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("'`{"uuid":"bad","lastTimestamp":"invalid"}`), 0600))
    r, err := NewReporter(cfg, logrus.New())
    require.NoError(t, err)
    _, err = uuid.FromString(r.state.UUID)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.Empty(t, r.state.LastTimestamp)
}

func readState(t *testing.T, path string) state {
    t.Helper()
    data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    var s state
    require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &s))
    return s
}
